name: Inline edit
description: Rename in place. Keep the context.
detail: A label opens into an editable surface, then returns to its accepted value. Save and cancel stay within the same place.
when: Project names, short titles, and metadata that can be edited in place.
integration: Connect value and onCommit to the actual update. Resolve only after saving succeeds, reject on failure, and update the controlled value after acceptance. Optional validate returns a readable error. Enter saves; Escape or Cancel discards an idle draft. During a pending save, Escape or Close only hides the editor: the operation continues and new commits remain blocked until settlement. Composition input never submits early. The preview changes local data only. Replay must not save or move focus.
props: value, defaultValue, onCommit, validate, label, speed, radius, className, style
